Start writing here. This file lives in `blogs/posts/` — once saved with a
`.qmd` (or `.ipynb`) extension it automatically appears on the Blogs page and
the homepage "Latest Writing" section on the next render.

Tips:

- `date` controls ordering (newest first). Use ISO format: `2025-01-01`.
- `image` is the thumbnail on listing cards — path relative to this file, or
  absolute from the site root with a leading `/`.
- `categories` become the filterable tags shown on cards.
- Delete the `image:` line if the post has no thumbnail.
